```{r}
library(rms)
require(tinytable)
# options(prType = c('latex', 'typst', 'html')[2])
fmt <- knitr::pandoc_to()
cat('Format:', fmt, '\n')
cat(fmt, '\n', file='/tmp/z', append=TRUE)
options(prType = fmt)
loadpkg(rms)
```

```{r}
set.seed(1)
n <- 1000
age <- rnorm(n, 50, 7)
sex <- sample(c('male', 'female'), n, TRUE)
y <- sample(0:1, n, TRUE)
z <- sample(runif(20), n, TRUE)
x1 <- runif(n)
x2 <- runif(n)
x3 <- runif(n)
i <- sample(1:n, 30, FALSE)
j <- sample(1:n, 40, FALSE)
age[j] <- x1[i] <- x2[i] <- x3[i] <- NA
# sex can't have NAs if used in strat()
dd <- datadist(age, sex, y, z, x1, x2, x3)
options(datadist='dd')

S <- Surv(1:n)
f <- lrm(y ~ rcs(age, 4)*sex)
# w <- latex(f)
u <- '
$$P(\\mathrm{y}=1) = \\frac{1}{1+\\exp(-X\\beta)}, \\mathrm{~~where}$$
$$\\begin{array}{ll}
X\\hat{\\beta}= & \\\\
& 0.6608358 \\\\
& + 0.001374476  \\mathrm{age}-0.0003919127(\\mathrm{age}-39.69889)_{+}^{3}  \\\\
&  +0.001676937  (\\mathrm{age}-47.70627)_{+}^{3}-0.001674642 (\\mathrm{age}-52.71902)_{+}^{3}  \\\\
&   +0.0003896176 (\\mathrm{age}-61.19738)_{+}^{3}  \\\\
&  -1.341946[\\mathrm{male}] \\\\
&  +[\\mathrm{male}][0.01103733   \\mathrm{age}+0.0002697899 (\\mathrm{age}-39.69889)_{+}^{3}  \\\\
&  -0.001249603 (\\mathrm{age}-47.70627)_{+}^{3}+0.001304317  (\\mathrm{age}-52.71902)_{+}^{3}  \\\\
&   -0.0003245031(\\mathrm{age}-61.19738)_{+}^{3}  ] \\\\{} \\\\{}
[c]= & 1~\\mathrm{if~subject~is~in~group}~c,~0~\\mathrm{otherwise} \\\\
(x)_{+}= & x~\\mathrm{if}~x > 0,~0~\\mathrm{otherwise}\\end{array}$$
'
# cat(u, file='/tmp/a')
# knitr::asis_output(u)
```

```{r}
f
latex(f)
summary(f)
g <- cph(S ~ age + strat(sex), surv=TRUE)
g
latex(g)
anova(g)
summary(g)
```

```{r}
a <- ols(y ~ rcs(age, 3), x=TRUE, y=TRUE)
a
latex(a)
anova(a)
summary(a)
validate(a, B=20)
a <- Gls(y ~ rcs(age, 3))
a
latex(a)
a <- orm(z ~ rcs(age, 3))
a
latex(a, intercepts=TRUE)
summary(a)
a <- psm(S ~ rcs(age, 3))
a
latex(a)
summary(a)
a <- Rq(z ~ rcs(age, 3) + sex, x=TRUE, y=TRUE)
a
latex(a)
summary(a)
validate(a, B=20)
```

```{r}
f <- lrm(y ~ x1 + rcs(sqrt(x2),3) + log(sqrt(x3)) + age + sex, x=TRUE, y=TRUE)
f
latex(f)
anova(f)
summary(f)
validate(f, B=20)
validate(f, B=20, bw=TRUE, sls=0.75, rule='p')
```

```{r}
d <- data.frame(y, x1, x2, x3, age, sex)
a <- aregImpute(~ y + x1 + x2 + x3 + age + sex)
f <- fit.mult.impute(y ~ x1 + x2 + x3 + age + sex, lrm, a, data=d, lrt=TRUE)
v <- processMI(f, 'anova')
prmiInfo(v)
```
